key.name: tile-left
key.description: Tile the active window to the left half of the screen. Unbound by default.

key.name: tile-right
key.description: Tile the active window to the right half of the screen. Unbound by default.

key.name: maximize-window
key.description: Maximize the active window, or move it up the tiling stack

key.name: restore-window
key.description: Move the active window down the tiling stack, back to the mosaic

key.name: swap-left
key.description: Swap the active window with its left neighbor (mosaic or tiling)

key.name: swap-right
key.description: Swap the active window with its right neighbor (mosaic or tiling)

key.name: swap-up
key.description: Move the active window to its upper neighbor in the mosaic grid

key.name: swap-down
key.description: Move the active window to its lower neighbor in the mosaic grid

key.name: resize-left-edge
key.description: Snap the active window's width to the next smaller 5% preset (5 through 100 % of usable tiling width), keeping it centered and wrapping at the smallest step

key.name: resize-right-edge
key.description: Snap the active window's width to the next larger 5% preset (5 through 100 % of usable tiling width), keeping it centered and wrapping at the largest step

key.name: resize-top-edge
key.description: Snap the active window's height to the next larger 5% preset (5 through 100 % of usable tiling height), keeping it centered and wrapping at the largest step

key.name: resize-bottom-edge
key.description: Snap the active window's height to the next smaller 5% preset (5 through 100 % of usable tiling height), keeping it centered and wrapping at the smallest step
